release_notes: Added the MOOR Renderer Tournament specification surface inside COLONY.
Locked a backend-neutral moor.render/1 contract so MOOR apps can depend on one stable rendering service while implementations remain replaceable.
Current Three.js WebGL becomes the compatibility Champion until a challenger passes hard correctness, replay, benchmark, soak, fallback and rollback gates.
Defined eight renderer candidate families (R0-R7), 17 deterministic benchmark scene classes (B00-B16), mandatory telemetry, Pareto comparison and meaningful-win promotion rules.
Type renderer tournament, render spec, renderer lab, or build renderer. The last command seeds the Generator Generator with the full renderer challenger constraints.
